name: OutputValidationAgent
description: Compares each evidence bundle's observed output with its BRD expectation using deterministic checks (flow completed; document produced, readable, non-empty, requested format, reflects the input; reply, 2xx or page change; negative input visibly rejected; no server/page errors; stated time limits) and a Gemini judge per pass criterion whose 'met' claims must quote the actual output verbatim (verified; ungrounded claims downgraded). No final verdict.

inputs.name: app_classification
inputs.description: App type, given to the judge as context

inputs.name: run_id
inputs.description: Locates the artifact folder for full document text

outputs.name: output_validation
outputs.description: counts, results[{bundle_id, test_code, criterion_code, status, checks[{id, name, oracle, result, detail, weight}], judge{assessment, score, reasoning, criteria_results[{criterion, result, quote, quote_verified}], ungrounded_quotes}, core_failures, supporting_failures, summary}]
